messages:
emma: Pushed Seaglass v1-int5 (per-channel quant) to staging for the embed pipeline. Quick smoke please.
raj: on it. I'll run recall@1,3,10 on short/medium/long buckets. baseline=opal-emb-v1.
yvonne: freeze tokenizer v1.1 for parity; filter emoji/punctuation-only queries from short bucket. include topk_entropy + centroid_shift.
eval-bot: Job 200301 queued by raj. dataset=prod-simset-20k seeds=3 microbatches=64.
raj: early scalars: global recall@1 -0.8% abs vs baseline; short recall@1 -3.6% abs; recall@10 short -0.9%. medium/long within \u00b10.5%.
yvonne: can you paste 6 failing short queries with top5? want to see swap vs drift.
raj: sample:
q: "how to reset password"
baseline top1: "reset password steps" (cos=0.89)
seaglass top1: "account recovery options" (cos=0.84)
seaglass top2: "reset password steps" (cos=0.82)
=> mostly top1 swaps / close paraphrases.
emma: likely tie flips from reduced precision. try post-quant per-channel bias-correction and re-eval.
raj: re-ran with bias-corr patch: short recall@1 gap reduced 3.6% -> 1.2%. recall@3 nearly matched baseline.
emma: cost delta?
raj: ~20% cost reduction per token; latency p50 comparable with kv-cache off.
yvonne: ok. action items: 1) raj run 100k holdout with bias-corr and produce uMAP + centroid heatmap for short bucket; 2) infra add canary fallback to opal-emb when short_recall1_drop >2% for 5m; 3) emma draft short-note for model card listing short-query sensitivity.
infra-bot: Canary rule added: fallback_model=opal-emb-v1 trigger_short_recall1_drop_pct=2.0 window_minutes=5.
eval-bot: Holdout Job 200302 queued (100k, metrics=recall@1,3,10;topk_entropy;centroid_shift). ETA ~50m.
raj: will post holdout results here. thanks all.
